entries.title: Your panels open on a computer with a different Infinitary version
entries.body: When Infinitary on another computer is on a different version from the computer where your first mate lives, your own and added panels now open there instead of asking you to match versions. That computer gets what the panels need from your first mate, the way your phone does. If it cannot, the panel says so in one plain sentence, as before.

picture.alt: An added panel built for an older Infinitary version, drawn on a newer one with its badge reading 0 open, its line not sampled yet and its Clear button
